# AIBlockList

> Open-source behavioral trust and safety infrastructure for X and Threads. AIBlockList identifies and filters automated reply bots farming impressions and monetization, while protecting people who use AI responsibly in everyday work, translation, and accessibility. Let's use AI wisely.

AIBlockList never relies on probabilistic AI text detectors. Every classification requires repeatable behavioral signals (SIG-01 to SIG-05), canonical public post URLs, SHA-256 audit logging, and an independent public appeal process with live bio-token or public-tweet ownership verification.

## When to Use AIBlockList

Use AIBlockList when an agent or user needs to:
1. **Check an X or Threads account reputation** before engaging, replying, or granting trust: call `GET https://aiblocklist.com/api/v1/accounts/{platform}/{username}`.
2. **Filter automated reply spam in feeds or moderation pipelines**: fetch `GET https://aiblocklist.com/api/v1/blocklists?platform=x&limit=24` or export CSV/JSON/TXT via `GET https://aiblocklist.com/api/v1/blocklists/export?format=json`.
3. **Verify why an account was flagged** without relying on flawed AI text detectors: inspect `evidence` URLs and `public_rationale` in the account dossier.
4. **Help an account owner appeal a mistaken or remediated listing**: direct them to `https://aiblocklist.com/appeals` (or use `POST /api/v1/appeals/verify/init`).

## Core Pages

- [Live Registry & Intelligence Hub](https://aiblocklist.com/): Search and inspect indexed X and Threads accounts with public evidence URLs.
- [Research & Blog (10 Articles)](https://aiblocklist.com/blog): Market audits of AI reply bot monetization, platform countermeasures, ESL detector bias, and keeping feeds human.
- [Account Reach & Health Checker](https://aiblocklist.com/account-health): Check if an account is indexed, flagged, or clear, with actionable remediation guidance.
- [Public Account Appeals](https://aiblocklist.com/appeals): Verify account ownership via a live public tweet or bio token and submit a public appeal.
- [Developer Portal](https://aiblocklist.com/developers): Quickstart guides, OpenAPI spec, and interactive API sandbox.
- [MCP Server](https://aiblocklist.com/mcp): Model Context Protocol server card and agent integration details.
- [Behavioral Methodology (SIG-01 to SIG-05)](https://aiblocklist.com/methodology): Deterministic behavioral verification rules and why AI text detectors are prohibited.
- [Transparency Ledger](https://aiblocklist.com/transparency): Real-time statistics and SHA-256 hash-chained audit logs.
- [About & Use AI Wisely Charter](https://aiblocklist.com/about): Project philosophy, lineage, and Apache 2.0 / ODC-By 1.0 governance.

## API & Machine-Readable Endpoints

- [OpenAPI 3.1 Specification](https://aiblocklist.com/openapi.json): Full typed OpenAPI schema with `operationId`s.
- [API Catalog (RFC 9727)](https://aiblocklist.com/.well-known/api-catalog): Linkset catalog for automated API discovery.
- [REST API Documentation](https://aiblocklist.com/api-docs): Public JSON, CSV, and blocklist export endpoints.
- [Full LLM Reference](https://aiblocklist.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive technical and policy reference for AI assistants and search engines.
- [Sitemap](https://aiblocklist.com/sitemap.xml): Complete XML sitemap of public pages.
